import collections
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data_dict):
    if not data_dict:
        return None, "The distribution is uniform."

    counts = np.array(list(data_dict.values()), dtype=float)
    avg_count = np.mean(counts)

    is_uniform = np.all(np.abs(counts - avg_count) <= 1e-5)
    message = "The distribution is uniform." if is_uniform else "The distribution is not uniform."

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    unique_count_num = len(set(counts.tolist()))
    bins = min(10, unique_count_num) if unique_count_num > 0 else 1

    ax.hist(counts, bins=bins, edgecolor="black")

    category_names = list(data_dict.keys())
    x_positions = np.arange(len(category_names))
    ax.set_xticks(x_positions)
    ax.set_xticklabels(category_names, rotation=45, ha="right")

    ax.set_xlabel("Category")
    ax.set_ylabel("Count")
    ax.set_title("Distribution of Counts")

    return ax, message
